definitions.explanation: A chart showing days, weeks, and months of a year.

examples.japanese: カレンダーを{見|み}て{予定|よてい}を{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: To check the schedule by looking at the calendar.

examples.japanese: {壁|かべ}にカレンダーを{掛|か}ける。
examples.english: To hang a calendar on the wall.

examples.japanese: カレンダーに{予定|よてい}を{書|か}き{込|こ}む。
examples.english: To write plans on the calendar.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{年|とし}のカレンダーを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a calendar for the new year.

examples.japanese: カレンダーを{見|み}たら、{来週|らいしゅう}は{休|やす}みが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Looking at the calendar, there are many days off next week.

notes:
カレンダー is a loanword from English "calendar."

TYPES OF CALENDARS:
- {壁掛|かべか}けカレンダー: wall calendar
- {卓上|たくじょう}カレンダー: desk calendar
- {日|ひ}めくりカレンダー: daily tear-off calendar
- カレンダーアプリ: calendar app

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- カレンダーを{見|み}る: to look at the calendar
- カレンダーに{書|か}き{込|こ}む: to write on the calendar
- カレンダーを{掛|か}ける: to hang a calendar
- カレンダーをめくる: to turn the calendar page

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- {日付|ひづけ}: date
- {曜日|ようび}: day of the week
- {予定|よてい}: schedule, plan
- {暦|こよみ}: calendar (traditional)
- {年間|ねんかん}カレンダー: yearly calendar

JAPANESE ALTERNATIVE: {暦|こよみ} is the native Japanese word for calendar, often used for traditional calendars.
